skills.name: get_harness_status
skills.description: Check whether the reviewed local Harness² core is available and learning is enabled. Summarize briefly; do not read long hashes unless asked. This does not install anything or start optimization.

skills.name: start_harness_check
skills.description: Only on an explicit user request, start one OFFLINE Harness² integration check in the background. Uses scripted model responses and isolated worktrees, with no paid model calls. Returns a queued job, not proof of completion or intelligence gains. No candidate activation or repository installation occurs.

skills.name: harness_check_status
skills.description: Read the latest local Harness integration check or a specified job ID. Report completed, failed or cancelled honestly. An offline pass verifies plumbing only; it does not demonstrate model improvement or activate learned guidance.

skills.name: cancel_harness_check
skills.description: Cancel the user's local Harness check, or the latest check when no ID is provided. Stops only the owned background check, preserving partial artifacts for inspection.
